project_domacahrana_desc: Marketplace that connects local food producers with buyers, enabling people to enjoy fresh, homemade food while supporting local farmers.
project_cenko_desc: Browse all deals from Slovenian stores in one place, share shopping lists, scan receipts to track your spending and get personalized recommendations based on your shopping habits. Coming soon!

project_globalshapers_desc: Website for Shapers Academy, a program by Institute Global Shapers, organization under the World Economic Forum.
project_period_tracker_desc: Period tracking mobile app I built for my girlfriend. She needed a simple app to track her period without all the annoying ads and premium subscription offers.
project_kavarna_cukrarija_desc: Modern website for a café and patisserie in Kranj, Slovenia, complete with a digital menu.
project_companies_desc: Web directory of Slovenian companies, their domains and stock indices. Search and explore company data, all in one place.
project_amadejvidner_desc: Videography portfolio website showcasing creative video production work by Amadej Vidner.
domacahrana_overview_p1: Domača Hrana is an online marketplace connecting local food producers with buyers all across Slovenia. Producers create a profile, list what they grow or make, and buyers discover fresh, homemade food near them, supporting local farming and sustainable practices along the way.
domacahrana_overview_p2: The platform is built with SvelteKit, deployed on Cloudflare Workers with a D1 SQLite database.
domacahrana_feature1_desc: Browse local products and producers, with search and filtering options.
domacahrana_feature2_desc: Producers create and manage their own profile and product listings.
domacahrana_feature3_desc: Clean, responsive design that works well on both desktop and mobile devices.
potegnime_overview_p1: potegni.me is a web-based torrent search platform that gathers results from public trackers such as The Pirate Bay and YTS. Users can explore movies and series powered by TMDB, get random suggestions with the "Surprise me" feature and check the movie and series of the day, picked by admins.
potegnime_overview_p2: The platform is built with Angular on the frontend and ASP.NET API with JWT authentication on the backend. Scraper is an Express.js lightweight API and PostgreSQL is used as the primary database. A native torrent tracker is coming soon™.
potegnime_feature1_desc: Search torrents across multiple public trackers from a single place.
potegnime_feature2_desc: Discover content through TMDB, daily picks and the "Surprise me" mode.
potegnime_feature3_desc: JWT authentication with role-based access for regular users, uploaders and admins.
librelock_overview_p1: LibreLock is an open-source, secure, modern, self-hosted password manager for individuals and organizations. Store all your passwords, credit cards and notes in one secure vault.
librelock_overview_p2: All vault data is encrypted in the browser with AES-256-GCM before it ever reaches the server. The server stores only encrypted blobs it cannot read. The web app is built with Vue, the server with Go and SQLite, and everything ships with Docker Compose for easy self-hosting.
librelock_feature1_desc: AES-256-GCM encryption in the browser, the server never sees the actual data.
librelock_feature2_desc: Personal or organization mode with multiple users, roles, a shared vault and custom branding.
librelock_feature3_desc: Vault data is checked against the Have I Been Pwned breach database, scored for strength and flagged if reused.
librelock_feature4_desc: View active sessions with device and IP, and revoke them individually or all at once.
periodtracker_overview_p1: Period Tracker is a simple period tracking app I built for my girlfriend, with no ads and no annoying premium subscriptions. It works fully offline and all data stays on device.
periodtracker_overview_p2: Predictions adjust dynamically to past cycles, or you can switch to static mode with a fixed cycle length. Built with Flutter and a local SQLite database, published on Google Play, currently sitting at 100+ downloads.
periodtracker_feature1_desc: Effortless logging with insights like average cycle and period length.
periodtracker_feature2_desc: Dynamic predictions that adapt to past cycles, or a fixed static mode.
periodtracker_feature3_desc: Customizable notifications for the next period.
periodtracker_feature4_desc: No internet required, data stored on device, with support for offline transfer between devices.
companies_overview_p1: companies.si is a web directory of companies, their domains and stock indices. Browse almost 12,000 companies across more than 60 countries, search by name, ticker or domain, and explore them on an interactive world map.
companies_overview_p2: A client project built with SvelteKit, running on Cloudflare Workers with a D1 (SQLite) database.
companies_feature1_desc: Search and browse companies by name, ticker or domain.
companies_feature2_desc: Company headquarters plotted on a world map with status indicators.
companies_feature3_desc: Track company domains and membership in stock indices.
companies_feature4_desc: Admin panel for managing companies, domains and indices, with bulk import and export options.
amadejvidner_overview_p1: Portfolio website for Amadej Vidner, a videographer from Slovenia. Dark, minimal design that puts the video work front and center.
amadejvidner_feature1_desc: Featured video projects presented in a clean, cinematic layout.
amadejvidner_feature2_desc: Direct access to published video content.
amadejvidner_feature3_desc: Dark, distraction-free design focused on the work.
kavarna_overview_p1: Website for Kavarna & Cukrarija, a café and patisserie on the main square of Kranj, with homemade cakes, great coffee. Includes a digital menu, photo gallery, opening hours and customer reviews.
kavarna_feature1_desc: Full digital drink and cake menu.
kavarna_feature2_desc: Photos of the café and its homemade cakes.
kavarna_feature3_desc: Opening hours, location and customer reviews.
shapers_overview_p1: Modern promotional website for Shapers Academy, an international career accelerator by Institute Global Shapers, an organization under the World Economic Forum. A landing page focused on conversions: program presentation, partner showcase and the application flow.
shapers_feature1_desc: Clear presentation of the academy, its partners and the application timeline.
shapers_feature2_desc: Prominent calls to action leading candidates to apply.
cenko_overview_p1: Cenko brings deals from all major Slovenian stores (Mercator, Spar, Hofer, Tuš, Lidl and Eurospin) into one app, making sure you always get the best price. Scan receipts to automatically track your spending and share shopping lists with family or friends.
cenko_overview_p2: Built with Flutter and a Supabase backend and a custom scraper collecting store deals. Winner of the Best Use of APIs award at Dragonhack 2026. Currently in development, coming soon!
cenko_feature1_desc: Browse and compare current deals across all major Slovenian stores.
cenko_feature2_desc: Scan receipts to automatically track spending with per-store insights.
cenko_feature3_desc: Share shopping lists with family or friends.
cenko_feature4_desc: Plan your shopping trips to minimize time spent shopping and maximize savings.
